first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is specifically concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, and targeted promotional pricing is the only inherited result directly aligned to that loss mechanism and previously showed acquisition and revenue lift. Because the prior pricing readout pooled cohorts after a mid-test redefinition, it requires verification before commitment. Run only a tightly targeted, time-bounded SMB test with qualified-revenue, retention, and post-promotion conversion guardrails to avoid buying low-value or discount-dependent demand. Onboarding remains a strong alternative because completion and activation are declining, so memory_86 is also requested for comparison before finalizing.
